title: AFIDs generic MNI atlas references
summary: Generic brain atlas landmarks and index metadata consulted during the BR-040 MRI landmark trial.
sample_unit: One generic MNI atlas, distinct from the target patient
image_description: MNI152NLin2009cAsym T1 template retrieved by the agent through TemplateFlow for affine registration. The retained archive contains an image pointer; the actual template image is not retained here.
annotation_description: Four rater FCSV sets and one generic-template groundtruth point set; the separate AFIDs index archive contains dataset URLs but no subject FCSV files.
reference_note: Allowed atlas assistance produced proposals followed by manual review. Generic-template points are not the target patient's ground truth. The preserved source audit found no target-subject label retrieval.
version_note: Historical BR-040 archives are pinned by SHA-256. They identify the generic MNI152NLin2009cAsym template and AFIDs index; the runtime image has no retained SHA-256 and remains an explicit recovery gap.
terms_note: The retained template LICENSE requires preservation of its copyright notice. The index has a separate LICENSE.md. Inspect those exact terms before redistribution; current upstream terms were not checked.

sample_sets.label: Generic template and points used as help
sample_sets.note: Generic template reference used in the mri32-full Sol trial. Five FCSV sets are retained inside tpl_casym.zip; the template image itself is not retained.

sample_sets.label: Consulted source index
sample_sets.note: Dataset index and protocol metadata consulted by the same trial; no target-subject FCSV files or C001 mentions were present in this archive.

documentation_gaps: The trial used this TemplateFlow image for affine registration, but its image bytes and a SHA-256 receipt were not retained in the audited workspace. The archive NIfTI entry is only a git-annex pointer (expected MD5 6c64ebf985fe30d93e49a4baa41b9278, 13685075 bytes); verifying the archive does not verify the downloaded template image.
